title: FTX-12b Cloth self-contact and contact speed-ups
description: Self-contact (sleeve against bodice, overlapping fronts, cuff folds; plan §11.4; the reference runs Blender self-collision at 2 mm, spec 04): cloth-cloth point-triangle and edge-edge pairs with the body-contact barrier, ACCD and lagged friction, excluding pairs that share a vertex. Speed-ups: cache candidates per solve (re-query only when motion exceeds the pad) and a precomputed CSR scatter instead of re-sorting triplets. title: FTX-12 Contact: distances, barrier, CCD, BVH, friction
description: Point-triangle and edge-edge distances with gradients/Hessians (dual-number oracle, ipc-toolkit formulas), IPC barrier on thickness-offset gaps, additive CCD step cap, BVH, lagged Coulomb friction, exact intersection audit. Plan: COMPREHENSIVE_PLAN_FOR_THE_DESIGN_OF_FRANKENTEXTILES.md §11.2, §11.5. Accept: known-answer tests 1, 4, 5, 6.
close_reason: Landed in ftx-drape: point-triangle/edge-edge distances (all regions) with exact derivatives via second-order forward AD (ad.rs Jet/Dual), IPC log barrier on the thickness-offset gap with the edge-edge mollifier, Gauss-Newton barrier Hessian (exact gradient), additive CCD step cap (s = 0.1), lagged smoothed Coulomb friction with lag rounds, start audit (gap, exact orient3d edge-through-triangle tests lifted from frankensim fs-ivl, winding-number inside test). Deviations: a BTreeMap uniform grid instead of a BVH (documented in CONTRACT). KAT 1 (calculus vs AD, differences, and the solver path to 1e-8), KAT 4 (2piuT = 2.531 N: 0.9 W* -0.012 mm, 1.1 W* -2.96 mm), KAT 5 (tan a = u/2 +0.11 mm, 2u -42 mm), KAT 6 (-10/-20 mm ease within dhat + 0.15 mm, hoop strain within 0.003; +30 mm clearance to 0.014 mm), KAT 9 contact digest c51df2cd... equal native debug/release and wasm32-wasip1. Self-contact and speed-ups filed as ftx-d0h.
